golay_elements — MV morphology op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.golay_elements(letter, rotation=0) (to call the implementation directly, import mvmorph; mvmorph.golay_elements(letter, rotation=0); from the registry, opsmv.get("golay_elements"))

• HALCON equivalent: golay_elements (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Build the 3x3 hit and miss structuring elements of a Golay letter with 45-degree rotation.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

letter は l / m / e / i / c。rotation は 45 度の時計回りの回数。実装していない文字は ValueError。

Args:

letter: Golay の文字。

rotation: 回転の回数(整数、8 で一周)。

Returns:

hit と miss(どちらも (3, 3) の bool)を持つ dict。
